summary: The CI-contract validator asserts a private copy of the container sentinel predicate, not the shipped one. The copy passes any run_preflight value when the heavy job was skipped; the shipped predicate requires exactly 'false'. Its seven cases never touch run-container-preflight.py.
proposed_fix: Import the shipped _required_sentinel_passes (the way test-hosted-windows-preflight.py:590 does) and assert against it, or delete the copy and its case list.

summary: The Claude manifest declares typesafe-jev as a hard dependency and the README says SpecKit Pro requires it. AGENTS.md says Jev is an optional tool and work goes on without it. The Codex manifest declares no dependency.
proposed_fix: Decide one status for Jev. Either soften the README and manifest to optional, or correct the AGENTS.md sentence and add a Codex-side note.

summary: refresh-local-plugin.py rebuilds dist through build-plugin-payloads.py only. That skips the runner trust-metadata recompute (refresh step 1) and the marketplace sync (step 3), so after a runner edit the local dist carries stale trust hashes. build-plugin-payloads.py is a second entry point to step 2 of refresh-release-artifacts.py and has no other caller.
proposed_fix: Have refresh-local-plugin.py call scripts/refresh-release-artifacts.py and delete build-plugin-payloads.py, or document that the local refresh needs a prior artifact refresh.

summary: The runbook says pr-checks.yml exposes validate-pr-title. That job lives in pr-metadata.yml, which also owns validate-release-note; the runbook lists neither workflow split.
proposed_fix: Name pr-metadata.yml as the owner of validate-pr-title and validate-release-note in baseline check 2.

summary: The status-to-exit-code table and required response fields are restated in the Windows preflight helper and in test-speckit-pro-gates.py, with no equality check against envelope.py.
proposed_fix: Import the table from speckit_pro_runner.envelope (the helper already puts the runner on sys.path) or add a drift test.

summary: Two scripts hold the same architecture-normalizing function and the same Windows interpreter and architecture probing. The container script names x86-64 'amd64' where the Windows helper names it 'x64', so evidence for one role uses two vocabularies. run-container-preflight.py (865 lines) also mixes change detection, Linux gates, Windows probing and the sentinel.
proposed_fix: Share one probe module for both, pick one family vocabulary, and split the Windows probing out of the container script.

summary: The fallback release title 'chore(release): release speckit-pro' is a literal in two scripts and is wrong for a typesafe-jev release PR. The dispatcher also hardcodes base_ref=main while every sibling honors BASE_REF, and it re-validates PR metadata instead of reusing resolve_release_prs.normalize_release_pr.
proposed_fix: Define the fallback once in resolve_release_prs.py, derive it from the component, and pass BASE_REF through.

summary: The pnpm pin is restated in sync_release_pr.py, check-toolchain.py, docs-site/package.json, release.yml and the docs page, with no single source.
proposed_fix: Read packageManager from docs-site/package.json in sync_release_pr.py and check-toolchain.py, or add a test that ties the literals together.

summary: The snapshot key set, the schema version literal 1 and FAILURE_OUTCOME are duplicated between the audit script and the composer. The composer keeps SNAPSHOT_SCHEMA_VERSION; the audit hardcodes 1.
proposed_fix: Share the snapshot schema and outcome constants in release_note_policy.py or a small module both scripts import.

summary: The composer re-exports underscore-private names (_label_names, _validation_inputs_from_environment) from the policy module and leaves them out of __all__. The policy module also owns CLI environment parsing.
proposed_fix: Make both helpers public in release_note_policy.py, add them to __all__, and move the PR_* environment reader to the composer.

summary: REQUIRED_SKILLS names ten codex-skills but omits speckit-install and speckit-upgrade, which exist in skills/ and codex-skills/. The check would not notice either being dropped. The file also mixes speckit-pro manifests, typesafe-jev provenance and versions, and the curated-set catalog.
proposed_fix: Derive the roster from skills/ (or the agent inventory) and split typesafe-jev and curated-set checks into their own files.

summary: Runner-invocation evidence and its schema allow operations (scaffold, status, autopilot-dry-run, doctor, update, autoheal) that envelope.py rejects. The runner accepts only preflight and runtime-info, and runtime-info is absent from the schema. The live-host case is named runtime-info but records status.
proposed_fix: Align the enum with the envelope vocabulary or document that the field names skill operations, not runner operations.

summary: The Claude payload copies .claude-plugin, skills, agents, hooks and speckit_pro_runner with the optional copier, so a missing source directory yields a passing empty payload. The Codex side uses the required copier for skills. AGENTS.md says gates fail closed.
proposed_fix: Use copy_required_installed_plugin for the directories the payload cannot ship without.

summary: The docs-affecting path set lives in classify-docs-validation.py and again in deploy-docs.yml paths. The classifier counts any tests/speckit-pro change (fixtures included) as reference-affecting; the deploy trigger excludes fixtures. Version Fields also says the Claude marketplace entry omits version, which is true only for speckit-pro (typesafe-jev's carries 0.9.2).
proposed_fix: State the path set once, or add a test comparing the two lists. Scope the Version Fields sentence to speckit-pro.

summary: The 'shell' toolchain mode runs the same checks as 'tests' under a different label, in a repository with no Bash dependency. The mode set is listed in check-toolchain.py and three times in suite.py; run-all.py still selects shell as a fallback.
proposed_fix: Drop the shell mode, or derive the mode set from one constant.

summary: About thirty unit tests each define the same importlib file loader, and no shared helper exists in tests/speckit-pro/lib. changed_files_for_base is duplicated between check-go-module.py and classify-docs-validation.py.
proposed_fix: Add one load_script helper to tests/speckit-pro/lib and one shared changed-files function in scripts/.

summary: run-default-suite.json lists six layer keys, including integration and parity, which the manifest marks non-default, and it restates the manifest roster by hand. The name says default; the request is the CI suite.
proposed_fix: Rename it to the CI suite and derive the roster from the manifest, or drop the explicit list.
